title: People missing from native cultures, traced in census data

tellings.quote: heard there are uh people sometimes mysteriously missing from those native cultures. Um I know somebody who studies this in census data.

plain: People sometimes go mysteriously missing from native cultures, and the pattern can be traced in census data. Michels says this himself, as something he has heard, while talking with the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove, and adds that he knows someone who studies it in census records. He gives no names, places or numbers.
